sample.name: Kong Chow Temple
facts: Temple to the god Guan Di, relocated to the Kong Chow Building in 1977.
The original Pine Street temple was destroyed in the 1906 earthquake and fire.

sample.name: Saints Peter and Paul Church
facts: The present church was completed in 1924 with twin spires rising 191 feet.

sample.name: Sentinel Building
facts: Completed in 1907 and listed as San Francisco Designated Landmark No. 33.
Francis Ford Coppola bought it in 1973; it houses his film studio American Zoetrope.
